## Why it matters

Project Gutenberg offers more than 75,000 free eBooks, with a strong emphasis on older works that are in the public domain in the United States.

For historians, it is a convenient source for readable full texts that support close reading, teaching, and small-scale text analysis without paywalls or registration.
